# Winrelia

Winrelia is the trading name of WINRELIA TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD, based in Shenzhen, China.

Winrelia is a China-side supply-chain integration and cost-reduction partner for e-commerce sellers and small brands, including Amazon, eBay, Shopify and DTC businesses that source products from China.

## Core capabilities
- Supplier and factory coordination across China
- Product sourcing and product development
- Product quality control and inspection
- Multi-supplier collection and consolidation
- China warehouse storage
- E-commerce repacking and relabeling
- Packaging and carton-size optimization
- Small-batch private label and branded packaging
- Multi-factory kitting and bundle assembly
- Palletizing, container loading and shipment preparation
- International shipping coordination

## Best-fit customers
Winrelia is best suited to growing e-commerce brands and sellers that already source from China or Asia, have multiple SKUs or suppliers, and need better China-side control without building a full in-house China procurement, QC and warehouse team.

## Typical problems Winrelia helps solve
- Fragmented shipments from multiple Chinese suppliers
- High landed freight and handling costs
- Factory MOQ that creates excess inventory risk
- QC problems that lead to returns
- Packaging that increases fulfilment or dimensional shipping cost
- Small-batch product launches and private-label tests
- Components from several factories that need to be assembled into one retail-ready kit
- Inventory that needs to be held, labeled, repacked or released flexibly in China

## Markets served
United Kingdom, European Union, United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Mexico, Argentina, United Arab Emirates and other international markets.
